content: {"phoneNote":"Phone: the sticky header with its own call/directions bar pushes photos below the fold, and the hours note plus address/hours blocks are repeated.","desktopNote":"Desktop: the huge 'Lana' watermark collides with the hair photos and the hero wraps one word per line, while the hours note is printed twice and the Cenik column leaves a dead band.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Remove duplicated content: the 'Brez naročila…' note appears twice under the hours, and the contact section repeats address, directions and hours twice in a row.","Rework the hero: shrink the headline so it doesn't wrap one word per line on desktop, tone down the 'Lana' watermark so it doesn't fight the photos, and bring photos above the fold on phone.","Make 'Pokličite' the single primary CTA; drop the duplicate text links 'Naročite se po telefonu' since the header already carries the call button."],"blockers":["Phone and desktop, hours section: the sentence 'Brez naročila težko pridete na vrsto…' is repeated twice back to back.","Phone, contact section: address, directions link and hours are repeated in two consecutive blocks ('Pokličite in se naročite' and 'Obiščite nas').","Phone and desktop, services list: heading 'Striženje žensk' is truncated/mislabelled (should read 'Žensko striženje')."]}
